$comment: Rules Claude Code enforces with hooks instead of instructions (.claude/hooks/context-stability.py). Kinds: command (when/require/forbid/unless regexes on Bash commands), path (Edit/Write denied on globs), commit (ifChanged globs need a requireChanged file in the same commit), stop (checked once before Claude finishes).

rules.message: Commit subjects start with `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `refactor:` or `test:` (CLAUDE.md section 4).
